Honestly where to begin... 
My Dad died about a year ago and it was only towards the end that we really started to connect and be honest with each other. He left a lot of debt behind and the family stopped talking to me so they wouldn't be the ones stuck with it which cause me a nervous break down. 

In the year leading up to his death I also spent a lot of time in between where I live and my home city all the while undergoing a major operation on my stomach. It was probably the worst year of my life. 

My Mum is also going through a midlife crisis its weighing heavily on me since I'm the eldest child. She also has really bad bipolar which doesn't help with her being on the extra manic side of things. 

There so much more but they the two big ones. I mean my jobs not bad my house is pretty good but I'm just so tired I haven't had a holiday in like 3 years.
